stories.title: CDA directs removal of 'unauthorised' construction at JUI-F chief's residence in Islamabad
stories.brief: The notice affixed outside the residence of the JUI-F chief — addressed to the legal owner of the property and dated Oct 30 (Friday) — highlighted three violations under the Islamabad Capital Territory Building Control Regulations 2020 (amended 2023). The authority directed that the mentioned violations be removed within 15 days, starting Friday.

stories.title: CDA gives Fazlur Rehman's residence 15 days to remove alleged encroachments
stories.brief: The Capital Development Authority (CDA) on Friday issued an encroachment notice at the residence of Jamiat Ulema-e-Islam-Fazl (JUI-F) chief Maulana Fazlur Rehman, identifying illegal constructions and encroachments on its land and directing their removal within 15 days.

stories.title: PPP courts opposition for electoral reforms
stories.brief: The Pakistan Peoples Party (PPP) on Friday intensified its efforts to secure opposition participation in the proposed parliamentary committee on electoral reforms as a party delegation met Senate Opposition Leader Allama Raja Nasir Abbas to urge him to join the initiative.

stories.title: PPP delegation calls on Senate opposition leader, urges participation in proposed committee on electoral reforms
stories.brief: On Friday, another PPP delegation, comprising the party’s secretary general Nayyar Bokhari, Senator Waqar Mehdi, Nadeem Afzal Chan and Rehman, visited Senate Opposition Leader Allama Raja Nasir Abbas with yet another invitation to join the proposed body.

stories.title: Pakistan, Saudi Arabia agree to boost cooperation in oil, refineries and minerals
stories.brief: Both sides underscored that the strong defence and strategic partnership between Pakistan and Saudi Arabia provides a foundation for broader regional peace, stability and economic cooperation.

stories.title: PTI K-P division dispels impression of internal discord

stories.title: Pakistan, Saudi Arabia agree to deepen cooperation in oil and energy sector
stories.brief: Pakistan and Saudi Arabia on Friday agreed to further strengthen cooperation in oil storage, refinery upgradation, liquefied petroleum gas (LPG) supplies and minerals. The understanding was reached during a meeting between Petroleum Minister Ali Pervaiz Malik and Saudi Ambassador to Pakistan Dr Rajeh Tami Albugamy in Islamabad.
